records._source_note: https://us.qidi3d.com/blogs/news/abs-3d-printing-success-guide (official QIDI ABS guide): nozzle ~235C, fine-tune in 5C increments -> 230-240; heated bed ~110C -> 100-110. Density/drying not published by QIDI on its own pages, left null. REPLACED an earlier lookalike-domain (qiditech3dprinter.com) record whose bed 80-100 conflicted with QIDI's official 110C.

https://gst3d.eu/pages/calibracion (also https://gst3d.eu/pages/faqs) ; GST3D official calibration/FAQ table: ABS nozzle 230-250C, bed 90-110C, requires enclosure.
